title: Merlin
paper_title: Merlin: a Computed Tomography Vision-Language Foundation Model and Dataset
core_mech: 以 I3D ResNet-152 原生编码完整 CT，并用 EHR phenotype prediction 与 Clinical Longformer 报告对比进行多源多任务预训练。
core_mech_en: Native 3D abdominal CT foundation model encoding whole volumes with an I3D ResNet-152 supervised jointly by EHR diagnosis codes (phenotypes) and radiology reports.
input_desc: 三维 CT 体积、同检查放射报告与 EHR diagnosis codes
input_en: Volumetric 3D abdominal CT scan + paired free-text radiology report + longitudinal EHR ICD diagnosis codes
output_desc: 检查级 3D 视觉语言表征及零样本/适配后临床任务输出
output_en: Study-level 3D visual-linguistic representation supporting zero-shot findings, EHR phenotype prediction, and 3D segmentation
gaps: The Merlin 3D imaging and clinical-text pretraining pipeline has not been integrated; random 3D classification is not Merlin.
